about: Page config for cf.daboodah.com (replaces the school reports' roster.json).  seasons: every season the page carries; the newest is the current season, the only one that refreshes (earlier seasons are collected once and sealed).  default_teams: the Team tab's selection on open, by team name as it appears in the registry (ESPN location name) plus season; never an id.  caps: the most selections the Team and Player pickers allow at once.  site: page and bot identity.  registry_aliases: cfbstats.com team-index name -> ESPN location name, for names the two sources spell differently (the join is proven by the cfbstats season cross-check, never by the alias alone).
